entities.name: Kroxa
entities.description: The titan of Death's Hunger on Theros, imprisoned in the Underworld and possessed by endless hunger.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane of the gods and titans.

entities.name: The Underworld
entities.description: Where the gods sealed the titans.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: God of fate who volunteered to be the titans' jailer.

entities.name: Kunoros
entities.description: Entrusted to control Kroxa; acts as his warden.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Theros
entities.description: Invasion whose Invasion Tree penetrated the Underworld.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: City Kroxa would eat in a day if freed.

events.summary: The gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld, with Klothys as eternal jailer.
events.quote: the gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld

events.summary: Kroxa consumed the advancing Phyrexian forces so utterly that no remnants remained.
events.quote: Kroxa consumed the invading forces so utterly that no remnants remained

events.summary: Athreos broke Kroxa's chains, and entrusted Kunoros to guide him against the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Athreos chose to break Kroxa’s chains

relations.note: entrusted to guide Kroxa along routes Athreos dictates
relations.quote: Athreos entrusted Kunoros with the task of controlling and guiding the titan.
Athreos chose to break Kroxa’s chains
Kroxa's destructive power is directed primarily against the Phyrexian invaders
